source: Identical fixed normalized shell-tree source; no source tree/scaffold is supplied to the field. Geometric scaffolds stored in the reused data are ignored.
data_scope: Reuse the same checksum-bound clean TRAIN coordinate subset and exclusions from the completed manifold study. No prior evaluation states or geometry/chemical edge labels are fitted.
coupling: Same typed source pairing with shared augmentation; linear position schedule and displacement head at T=1.
objective: Same velocity FM loss and update budget as the original one-pass reference. Internal geometry is either fixed at Xt or Xt+(1-t)*accumulated_velocity; output remains Xt+accumulated_velocity. No additional trainable parameters.
primary: Time-scaled internal geometry versus original velocity-coordinate geometry and fixed-current-geometry control; existing two-pass geometry SC is an additional stronger-compute training reference.
pilot_gate: Time-geometry graph-rate point gain over BOTH plain and fixed_geometry in both seeds, pooled paired95 lower bounds positive over both, and no >2pp loss in distinct connectivity per attempt versus plain. Always report geometry-SC performance and costs; this gate does not establish superiority over every reference.
claim_boundary: The endpoint/velocity identity is standard. The candidate is a time-aware internal geometry representation in coordinate-updating velocity networks, not a new flow-matching theorem. An original learned-method contribution and broad usefulness still need evidence.
failure_rule: No post hoc time-envelope, LR, width, data, integration or sampling-budget sweep on this panel. Baseline checkpoints match the exact warm/data/source/training recipe and get new source streams.
novelty_status: implemented candidate, no improvement result yet
